structured.answer: It seems worth having: the employer adds up to 7.5% of my salary, I add 2.5%, and after 6 years I can take it all out without tax; taking it out earlier is possible but expensive. I would still ask my son or the payroll office what they actually invest it in before signing.

stuck.why: English letters S&P 500, fund names with numbers, and a slider; it felt like investments, not savings
Many numbers with dotted lines and a minus sign '−342.02 ₪'; I got anxious and backed away
'47%' frightened me; I wasn't sure whether that much is taken from me

used: Title and subtitle 'קרן השתלמות – חיסכון ... בפטור ממס'
'כסף נכנס ויוצא' cards: 'כשעוברות 6 שנים', 'עד 4 ימי עסקים'
'כמה זה עולה' table: 'עד 2% בשנה', 'דמי יציאה – אין'
Orange warning 'משיכה לפני הזמן אפשרית, אבל יקרה'
'אין ערבות של המדינה' in risks section
skimmed: Cost/tax numbers and bullet list on screen 3
skipped: Slider 'אחרי כמה שנים מושכים את הכסף?'
Screens 7 and 8 ('מה האתר לקח בחשבון', 'מונחים') – too tired
not_found: A plain sentence saying whether the money is as safe as a deposit
What exactly my money is invested in if I choose nothing
Who runs this site, whether it is official

findings.what: Early on, English 'S&P 500' and 'מדד' buttons make it feel like a stock-market page, not savings
Busy calculator with many decimals and a minus sign; frightening and unclear what it means
Dark background with pale grey small text, hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: All screens, e.g. 'ההכנסה: דוגמה של האתר', 'גררו את הסמן'

findings.what: Slider to pick years; I won't use sliders
'47%' in the warning is alarming without explaining plainly what I would lose
Codes like TXH-09, PF-18 mean nothing to me
'אין ערבות של המדינה' worries me with no reassurance next to it
Unknown site name 'מקור', not a bank, so I'm not sure I can trust it
